title: chore(examples): add e-commerce theme [part 3]
body:
_This is part 3 of the series "e-commerce demo"._

## Description

This adds the widget styles for the e-commerce theme. It doesn't yet add the demo-specific widget styles.

## Notes

- The theme styles are overriding the CSS classes generated by InstantSearch to later be extracted as a theme
- The styles are alphabetically ordered
- The main SearchBox style is part of the demo style (next PR)
- The Hits style is part of the demo style (next PR)
- The outlines were removed for now, waiting for a specific design
- The Panel for the RangeInput takes the RangeSlider into account in the demo styles (next PR)
- The RangeInput "Go" button remains unstyled because the design is missing
- The ToggleRefinement style is by default aligned on the left (the demo styles will reverse the order in the next PR)
- RatingMenu selected style is temporary until we've got a designer's POV

## Preview

[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3801--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/)
